Appam with Stew.note: Rice and coconut batter raised with yeast (no toddy); coconut milk is not milk; cashew nuts = tree nuts; chicken. Mild = 1. Breakfast only.

Puttu and Kadala Curry.note: Rice flour puttu (no gluten by default; wheat puttu is an option); mustard seeds = mustard (rule m); coconut is not a tree nut. Mildly spicy. Breakfast only.

Idiyappam with Egg Curry.note: Rice flour string hoppers; boiled eggs; mustard seeds; coconut gravy. Spicy. Breakfast only.

Rava Upma.note: Semolina = wheat; ghee = milk; mustard seeds; cashew nuts; urad dal is not soy. Mild. Breakfast only.

Kerala Fish Curry.note: Tenggiri; mustard seeds; fenugreek (not a regulated allergen); coconut oil. Very spicy.

Fish Moilee.note: Tenggiri; mustard seeds; coconut milk (not milk). 'Mild' gravy with green chilli = 1. Sold out.

Prawn Roast.note: Prawns = crustaceans; coconut slivers are not tree nuts. Spicy.

Chicken Roast.note: Chicken, onion, ginger, garlic, chilli, fennel, coconut oil. No listed allergen. Spicy.

Beef Fry.note: Beef, coconut slivers, pepper, fennel, garlic, coconut oil. No listed allergen. Pork-free branch, no alcohol: halal by ingredients. Spicy.

Vegetable Avial.note: Yoghurt = milk; coconut is not milk. Not spicy.

Sambar.note: Asafoetida stated with wheat flour = gluten; mustard seeds; toor dal is not soy. Mildly spicy.

Rasam.note: Mustard seeds; no asafoetida named. Peppery and mildly spicy = 1.

Cabbage Thoran.note: Mustard seeds; urad dal; coconut. Mild = 1.

Papadam.note: Urad dal flour, coconut oil. No listed allergen.

Ghee Rice.note: Ghee = milk; cashew nuts. Fried onion. Not spicy.

Thalassery Chicken Biryani.note: Ghee and yoghurt = milk; cashew nuts; chicken. Mild.

Veg Sadya Meal.note: Union of components: sambar (wheat asafoetida, mustard), rasam and thoran (mustard), avial and pachadi (yoghurt), payasam (ghee, cashews). Stated mildly spicy.

Non-Veg Meal.note: Union: fish fry (tenggiri), sambar (wheat asafoetida, mustard), thoran (mustard), moru buttermilk = milk; chicken curry. Stated spicy.

Parotta Beef Fry Combo.note: Union: Malabar Parotta (wheat, egg, milk, ghee), Beef Fry (spicy), Sulaimani Tea.

Pazham Pori.note: Wheat and rice flour batter; coconut oil. Beef fry side and ice cream are add-ons, not counted; the ice cream is the add-on that is out.

Payasam.note: Ghee = milk; cashew nuts; coconut milk is not milk.

Sulaimani Tea.note: Black tea, lemon, spices, sugar; stated no milk.

Buttermilk.note: Buttermilk = milk; green chilli, stated mild = 1.

Tender Coconut.note: Coconut is not a tree nut.
